text: This study finds no evidence of an inverse relationship between the size of regulated hedge fund advisers and the per-unit cost of compliance, contrary to the common complaint that financial regulation brings increasing returns to scale.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, The Impact of Dodd-Frank Act Compliance Cost on the Hedge Fund Industry (2014). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2389423

isBasedOn.name: The Impact of Dodd-Frank Act Compliance Cost on the Hedge Fund Industry

abstract: The author finds no evidence of an inverse relationship between the size of regulated hedge fund advisers and the per-unit cost of compliance.

value: survey data collected after the March 2012 registration effective date for hedge fund advisers under Title IV
